methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Kunin, a robotics and manufacturing company founded by Daniel Rau and Corey Donovan, sits within a sector comprising 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private peers including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The company's current stage and valuation remain undisclosed, as does total capital raised to date.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. Despite 11 same-sector peers existing in Robotics & Manufacturing, insufficient clustering was achieved within narrow filtering criteria: zero peers matched on same stage, zero on adjacent stage, and zero within similar valuation tier. A median derived from all-sector comparables would introduce unacceptable measurement error given the wide dispersion typical across robotics ventures at different development and revenue stages.

The available comp universe—predominantly early-to-growth stage private firms alongside a single public reference point—provides directional context but lacks the homogeneity required for reliable quantitative triangulation. Valuation support cannot be derived from this dataset alone. Meaningful analysis would require either tighter stage / revenue / customer segmentation within the private peer set, or disclosure of Kunin's own financials (revenue, burn rate, customer count) to enable earnings multiple or revenue multiple methodologies against better-matched subsets. Key uncertainties center on Kunin's operational scale relative to named peers and the appropriate discount rate given undisclosed funding history.
